method: Same-season (peak and dry) cloud-masked Sentinel-2 composites. 'Water' is wet extent: open water (MNDWI) OR Dynamic World water OR flooded vegetation, so floating weeds and marsh are not counted as loss. Loss = baseline peak wet extent absent in both seasons for two consecutive years. Classified by Dynamic World built-area probability. Urgency uses absolute scales and built-up growth in a 500 m ring.
limitations: Sentinel-2 is 10 m: changes narrower than about 30 m are treated as uncertain, not encroachment.
Baseline is 2017-2018, so earlier encroachment is not detected.
'Seasonal' means non-built loss (drought, drying, vegetation), not proven seasonality.
Flooded-vegetation detection can confuse wet grass or crops with lake surface.
Indicative analysis from satellite imagery, not legal evidence.
